title: Sell tobacco products only in compliant retail packaging
what: Tobacco products held or sold in retail packaging must meet the tobacco product requirements (plain packaging and health warnings).

laws.title: Public Health (Tobacco and Other Products) Act 2023

sources.title: Public Health (Tobacco and Other Products) Act 2023
sources.quote: 96 Possessing tobacco products in non-compliant retail packaging (1) A person contravenes this subsection if: (a) the person possesses a tobacco product; and (b) at the time of possession, the product is in retail packaging; and (c) the retail packaging does not comply with a tobacco product requirement.
